inputs.name: nextLoopStep.input
inputs.description: The object identifies the loop whose state should be read; root optionally selects the repository root and otherwise the current working directory is used. The inherited now callback is unused by this read operation, and the loop must have a readable, valid loop.json.

inputs.name: renderNextLoopStep.result
inputs.description: The value supplies the loop name and relative trace path, with an optional step and evaluator. The renderer prints the loop, step id and title when present, and evaluator command when present; it omits the trace path and other metadata.

outputs.name: nextLoopStep
outputs.description: The promise resolves to the loop name and relative trace path, plus the first pending step in the stored steps array when one exists. Its evaluator is included only when one is configured for that step.

outputs.name: renderNextLoopStep
outputs.description: The returned text contains the loop line and either the next step line or a complete line. It adds an evaluator line only when an evaluator is present.
examples:
Loop: contract-audit
Next: review-contract - Review the workflow contract

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised when loop.json is missing or its parsed object fails the loop-state schema.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Propagated when loop.json contains invalid JSON.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Filesystem read errors other than a missing-file error are rethrown by readLoop.
